description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for validating an employee's work email within the OrangeHRM system. It provides functionality to check if the email is unique for the specified employee.

classes.name: ValidationEmployeeEmailAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoint for validating an employee's work email address, ensuring uniqueness within the system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to validate an employee’s work email by employee number, returning whether the email is unique.
